prompt.project_info: Photorealistic four-frame lifestyle fashion collage in a Mediterranean estate garden.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long dark-brown center-parted hair, joyful carefree expressions and natural movement, wearing a soft pink maxi dress with small red-and-green floral print, short puff sleeves, fitted bodice and flowing skirt, understated earrings, light-brown ankle boots and sunglasses in one frame.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical four-image grid collage combining full-body and medium shots: front-facing walk, rear three-quarter view, close medium laughter, and side movement; arches, columns, flower beds, lawn, trees, distant mountains, blue sky and lush grounds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural midday light with soft defined shadows, cheerful vibrant romantic countryside-resort atmosphere and gentle background separation.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution lifestyle fashion editorial photography, crisp subject detail, moderate depth of field, natural fabric movement and realistic color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic four-image grid collage using the attached approved-adult woman reference: long dark-brown center-parted hair, joyful carefree expressions, soft pink floral maxi dress with puff sleeves and flowing skirt, understated earrings, light-brown ankle boots and sunglasses in one frame; show front walk, rear three-quarter view, close laughter and side movement in a Mediterranean estate garden with arches, columns, flowers, lawn, trees, mountains and bright natural midday light.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, duplicated panels, inconsistent outfit, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay
